warnings: Purlin splice: two C-100x50x20x3.2 purlins butted and spliced with a 0.15 long C-100x50x20x2.3 'เหล็กดาม', welded full length. The cross-section label reads 'แปเหล็ก Z, C' — the purlin may be a Z or a C; S-04/S-07 print C, kept C.
ขยายรูปตัด A (cut mark A on S-07) shows the ⫫ members as two angles back to back with intermittent welds — confirms the 2L reading used for S-07 / S-08.
